description: What published prices imply for a holding of data: a low-to-high range in US dollars with the arithmetic behind it. Call it first with only `kind` to get the questions and their answer ids, ask the holder, then call again with `answers`. Questions not answered are taken at their defaults and marked as assumed. An indication, not an offer.

answers.description: Answer ids by question id, as returned in `questions` (for video, for example {"hours": "1000-10000"}); every answer is one of the listed answer ids, sent as text.

kind.description: What is being valued: records (Company records), code (Codebases), tasks (Training tasks), video (Video and footage), speech (Audio and speech), images (Images), text (Text and archives), environments (Simulated environments), robotics (Robot and physical-world data).

name: value_data
title: Value a holding of data from public prices
